description: Parentheses around a select item's column reference are TRANSPARENT at any depth: the projected column keeps the source column's name, canonical type and nullability - (v), ((v)) and (t.v) all agree with v, numerics keep precision/scale, an alias still wins the name, a nullable source stays nullable, and SHOW COLUMNS' descriptor carries the column's own length. Live-verified. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ParenthesizedColumnItemTest (now retired). Plus REAL and DOUBLE PRECISION as FLOAT synonyms in CREATE TABLE and CAST, with real/precision staying usable as identifiers - converted 1:1 from ddl/RealDoublePrecisionTypeTest (now retired).
